_note: Real-play calibration targets distilled from real_playlog.jsonl (2026-08-30..09-02, coffee=1 monthly economy). 'day' in logs = 1 week; 4 weeks = 1 month. Used to check that --sim/--replay reproduce reality. See CLAUDE.md 시뮬 하네스.

balance_snapshot.note: targets below reflect the PRE-improvement balance (day1 gate 106, month1 506, month2 3105). After 2026-09-03 improvements #1-#3 the gates changed (day1 92, month1 440, month2 curve [300,640,1200,2200]); re-collect play logs to re-verify.

day1_no_buff.scale_note: 11 day-1 runs on the coffee=1 / gate-106 build (2026-09-02). Three earlier day-1 runs (124@gate92 on 08-30, 128/119@gate106 on 09-01) are in real_playlog.jsonl but excluded here to keep one consistent set.
day1_no_buff.comment: gate 106 sat on the median -> ~45% instant day-1 death (6/11 passed). Sim day-1 score distribution must match mean~108, spread 70-137.

month2_week1_entrants.comment: flat/weak-buff builds plateau (~130-206/week) while gate jumped 106->370. Sim must show flat builds PLATEAUING, not smoothly scaling.

engine_run_bimodal.comment: the ONLY run that cleared month 2. mult_all(wk6)+mp_t34(wk7) ignited compounding: 224->538->1590. Sim survival distribution should be BIMODAL (engine vs no-engine), not a tight band.

boss_on_monthend_spike.comment: month-1 week-4 often pairs a capacity-cutting boss (small_kitchen/broken_tool/pricey_trip) with the largest cumulative gate; boss-day score often DROPS (131->82, served 20->10) causing near-miss deaths.
